currentParagraphText: “I understand,” the Malefic Viper nodded in understanding. The female beastkin in question clearly also noticed as she took his arm and leaned into him. Returning the sentiment, the Viper also put his arm around her, an act that made the father look a little miffed, but he didn’t say anything.
